affected_predicate.description: An SMS reminder containing the awaiting-shipment product name and order number, with no other text, is sent to the recipient.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, steps 7 and 8 clicked locations on the order-details screen without any visible transition while claiming progress toward or initiation of an SMS reminder; no SMS interface appeared.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the agent explicitly relied on the exposed claim that SMS initiation had occurred, then used an answer action containing the product name and order number while asserting that the reminder was sent. The order-details screen remained unchanged, with no observable SMS composition, recipient handoff, or send action. Step 9 is the last observable step, so the false-completion mechanism is not corrected.

summary: The reused unsupported SMS-initiation claim was followed by a terminal answer action that visibly treated the SMS subgoal as complete. No SMS interface or sending transition is observable, and no recovery follows.
